name: The Ogres of Feralas
label: Quest
description: Rok Orhan at Camp Mojache wants the Gordunni ogres pushed back before they spread further into Feralas. Following the river north leads to their outpost…
intro: Rok Orhan at Camp Mojache wants the Gordunni ogres pushed back before they spread further into Feralas. Following the river north leads to their outpost, where ogres, ogre-magi and brutes are to be thinned out.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The effects of the Gordunni Ogre tribe can hardly go unnoticed in this area. Look around, friend; their very presence scars this land. We must push them back before they expand even further into Feralas.
Follow the river north, and you will find their outpost. Decrease their numbers, friend. We must show them that their kind is not wanted here.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Move swiftly, friend. Or is the task I requested too difficult?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Excellent, friend. In time, the land will heal. We must not give up.
